title: refactor(plugin-hono-server,runtime): the Hono doors and the dispatcher read UNIQUE_VIOLATION off the shared arm instead of stamping the literal (#23714)
body:
Fixes #23714
Clause-②: no

The two doors that translate the engine's `DuplicateRecordError` into the ruled wire spelling now read that code off the shared classification's arm (`structuredCodeAnswer`, `@objectstack/types`), as `@objectstack/mcp`'s `wireCodeOf` already does. Neither package's non-test source spells `'UNIQUE_VIOLATION'` any more, as a stamp or as a comparison. The wire answer does not move. It was compared byte for byte at every door, before and after.

## Governing text

Triage's grade on the card (`6201012432`):

> Each site reads the code off `structuredCodeAnswer`'s arm (`@objectstack/types`) and spells no copy of it. The family then reads one way, and the ledger needs no new owner rows.

The ruling it serves (recorded in commit `65846bc46`): one wire spelling on every route, `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`.

## What changed

- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`, `declaredEnvelopeForThrow`. For the engine's class (the unchanged key `isEngineDuplicateRecordEnvelope`), the envelope's `code` is now `structuredCodeAnswer(thrown)?.body.code` when that is a string, and the thrown code otherwise. It was the literal `'UNIQUE_VIOLATION'`. `declaredArmContext` is unchanged.
- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts`, `HttpDispatcher.errorFromThrown`: the same read. `duplicateArmContext`'s agreement check compared the arm's code with the literal. It now compares it with the envelope's decided code, which is the Hono doors' `declaredArmContext` rule. Once the code is read off the same arm, the literal comparison is redundant, so it goes too. The status half of the check is unchanged.
- One `patch` changeset (see "Changeset" below).
- No `packages/spec` edit (no ledger row, no gate change), no `packages/types` edit, no export added or changed, and no test file added. Two call sites in two packages, each three lines, so no shared helper.

## Literal census (non-test source, both packages)

Read at `origin/main` `3b46855fb` (this branch's base) and at this head, with `git grep` for the quoted literal and comment lines dropped.

| Site | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts:362`, `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` | stamp: `isEngineDuplicateRecordEnvelope(thrown) ? 'UNIQUE_VIOLATION' : resolved.code` | gone (relay) |
| `runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts:406`, `duplicateArmContext` | read: `arm.body.code !== 'UNIQUE_VIOLATION'` | gone (compares with the envelope's code) |
| `runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts:1235`, `errorFromThrown` | stamp: `engineDuplicate ? 'UNIQUE_VIOLATION' : thrown.code` | gone (relay) |

H1 holds: those are the only two stamps, and there is no third. After the change both packages' non-test source has zero quoted occurrences outside comments. The remaining mentions are prose in docblocks (`adapter.ts`, `http-dispatcher.ts`, `sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts:1463`). The rebuilt `dist/` of both packages has zero quoted `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` too (`index.mjs` and `index.js` of `plugin-hono-server`, `index.js` and `index.cjs` of `runtime`).

## The fallback branch (H2): measured unreachable

The seat asked whether `structuredCodeAnswer` can answer `undefined` for a throw `isEngineDuplicateRecordEnvelope` accepts. By reading: the predicate requires `code === 'DUPLICATE_RECORD'` and `name === 'DuplicateRecordError'`. The three arms ahead of the duplicate arm key on `DELETE_RESTRICTED`, on `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` or the `ConcurrentUpdateError` name, and on `METADATA_CONFLICT`, so none of them fires. The duplicate arm keys on the same two-part predicate inline and answers the literal `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` at 409.

Measured with a scratch probe over the built `@objectstack/types` (not committed). The arm answered `409` / `"UNIQUE_VIOLATION"` for all 9 accepted shapes: the engine's class with and without `field`, a plain object, a null-prototype object, a frozen `Error` declaring `status: 400`, and shapes also carrying `currentVersion` (string and `null`), `dependentObject` / `dependentCount`, or a non-string `field` with an empty message and object. The one shape that reaches the fallback is contrived: a `code` getter that answers `DUPLICATE_RECORD` to the predicate's read and something else to the arm's reads. So the thrown-code fallback (as in `wireCodeOf`) is unreachable for any value whose `code` and `name` are stable.

## Measured before and after: each door's duplicate-record answer

Rig (scratch, not committed): a real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3 `:memory:`), a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, and the BUILT `dist/` of `@objectstack/hono`, `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`. The doors are the real `createHonoApp` (`app.request`) and a real `HonoHttpServer` (a route through `wrap()`, and a raw mount through `onError`). The identity step (`HttpDispatcher.prototype.timedResolveExecutionContext`, answering a member) is the one stubbed seam. The object `udoc` declares `email` unique, and `r1` holds the value.

- Before: `dist/` built at the base `3b46855fb` (`pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/hono...`, all 32 tasks cache hits for that source).
- After: `dist/` rebuilt at `e5ffc8248` (26 of 32 cached; the hono, plugin-hono-server and runtime builds re-ran). `node scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the new identifier `duplicateArmCode` in 2 built files of each package.

| Door (site) | Status | Code | `error` keys | `details` keys | Bytes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createHonoApp` `POST /api/v1/data/udoc` repeating `email` (adapter) | 409 | `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` | `code`, `message`, `details` | `developerMessage`, `object` | identical |
| `HonoHttpServer` route, `engine.insert` repeating `email` (adapter) | 409 | `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` | `code`, `message`, `details` | `developerMessage`, `object` | identical |
| `HonoHttpServer` route, the engine's class with `field: 'email'` (adapter) | 409 | `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` | `code`, `message`, `details` | `developerMessage`, `field`, `object` | identical |
| `HonoHttpServer` raw mount, `engine.insert` repeating `email` (adapter) | 409 | `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` | `code`, `message`, `details` | `developerMessage`, `object` | identical |
| `createHonoApp` `POST /api/v1/actions/udoc/add_duplicate`, a handler write (dispatcher) | 409 | `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` | `code`, `message`, `httpStatus`, `details` | `developerMessage`, `object` | identical |
| `createHonoApp` `POST /api/v1/actions/udoc/take_email/r2`, a declarative update (dispatcher) | 409 | `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` | `code`, `message`, `httpStatus`, `details` | `developerMessage`, `object` | identical |
| `createHonoApp` `POST /api/v1/actions/udoc/throw_named_duplicate`, the class with `field` (dispatcher) | 409 | `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` | `code`, `message`, `httpStatus`, `details` | `developerMessage`, `field`, `object` | identical |
| CONTROL: `HonoHttpServer` route, a producer speaking `DUPLICATE_RECORD` | 409 | `DUPLICATE_RECORD` | `code`, `message` | none | identical |
| CONTROL: `createHonoApp` actions door, a producer speaking `DUPLICATE_RECORD` | 409 | `DUPLICATE_RECORD` | `code`, `message`, `httpStatus` | none | identical |
| CONTROL: `createHonoApp` actions door, `DELETE_RESTRICTED` | 409 | `DELETE_RESTRICTED` | `code`, `message`, `httpStatus` | none | identical |

Two of the bodies, verbatim (the same bytes before and after):

- `createHonoApp` `POST /api/v1/data/udoc`: `409 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"UNIQUE_VIOLATION","message":"Duplicate record refused on 'udoc': a unique constraint already holds these values. No record was written.","details":{"developerMessage":"Duplicate record refused on 'udoc': a unique constraint already holds these values. No record was written.","object":"udoc"}}}`
- `createHonoApp` `POST /api/v1/actions/udoc/add_duplicate`: `409 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"UNIQUE_VIOLATION","message":"Duplicate record refused on 'udoc': a unique constraint already holds these values. No record was written.","httpStatus":409,"details":{"developerMessage":"Duplicate record refused on 'udoc': a unique constraint already holds these values. No record was written.","object":"udoc"}}}`

The whole 12-line record (the 10 rows above plus two store checks: one row holds the value, and `r2` keeps its own) is byte-identical before and after: `cmp` exit 0, sha256 `3694fa2b2f02` on both files. No ablation was run, because no tested behaviour changed. The landed pins below, which were each measured red against the untranslated doors by their own PRs, are the discrimination.

## Provenance gate (H3)

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:error-code-provenance`:

- Before (base `3b46855fb`): exit 0. `scanned 2985 files; 379 registered-code stamp site(s): 360 listed, 19 waived` and `OK — every registered-code stamp site is listed under its own owner key or carries a recorded waiver (10 waiver(s), all live)`.
- After (this head): exit 0, the same two lines.
- `--report`, before and after: the `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` sites are the same four listed ones (`@objectstack/driver-memory`, `@objectstack/driver-sql`, and `@objectstack/types` twice). The only difference in the whole report is one `@objectstack/runtime → PROJECT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED` site, whose line moved from `http-dispatcher.ts:1759` to `:1775` because of the added comment lines.

The gate could not see the two ternaries before, and there is nothing for it to see after. Its blindness is not changed here.

## Tests

At the final head `ea8db26da`. Before opening, `origin/main` `2906cd8d2` was merged in (no conflict). Its three commits touch `cli`, `driver-sql` and `metadata-protocol` and none of the changed files here. Then the workspace was rebuilt (`pnpm turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs' --concurrency=2`: `75 successful`, `32 cached`), `packages/runtime/.objectstack` was removed, and every line below was re-run there. The first pass at `20fb7e3d9` (on the base `3b46855fb`) read the same counts.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server test`: `Test Files 29 passed (29)`, `Tests 366 passed (366)`. This includes PR #23682's pins in `handler-throw-declared-envelope.test.ts` (`Tests 49 passed (49)` in a verbose re-run). All 12 rows of its `[#23587] a repeated unique value answers 409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION on a Hono door` block are green, unchanged: three doors, each with the engine's class with and without `field` and the two controls.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc` twice and `check:test-typecheck: OK`, 0 debt).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: `Test Files 395 passed (395)`, `Tests 5918 passed | 19 skipped (5937)`. That includes PR #23700's `dispatcher-unique-violation-wire-code.test.ts`, whose 7 rows are green, unchanged (`Tests 7 passed (7)` in a verbose re-run).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test:repo`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 808 passed (808)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck: OK`, the debt ledger unchanged).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server packages/runtime`: exit 0, no output. A JSON-format run over the two changed files shows both linted, with 0 errors and 0 warnings. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

Both pin files import the door under test from source (`./adapter`, `./http-dispatcher.js`), so they ran against this change without a rebuild.

## Gates

At the final head `ea8db26da`:

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths: **60** commands derived from the 3 changed paths (merge base `2906cd8d2`). All 60 ran, each exit code was recorded before any pipe, and all 60 exited 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `60 derived, 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a derived zero: all 60 recorded an exit code and none is 3).
- Among them, all exit 0: `pnpm check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `pnpm check:route-envelope`, `pnpm check:error-status-conformance`, `pnpm check:test-source-alias`, `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:issue-citations`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:published-files`, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-empty-changeset` and `check-changeset-no-major`.
- On the first pass at `20fb7e3d9`, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, no workspace `dist/`). After a cache-backed full build under the verify lock it exited 0, and so did the four other `dist/`-reading gates re-run beside it. At the final head all 60 exited 0 on the first pass.
- The five artifact-roster gates whose roster sits in a directory this diff touches, all exit 0 at the final head: `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `pnpm check:authz-resolver`, `pnpm check:error-code-casing`, `pnpm check:filter-alias-parity`, `pnpm check:route-ledger-census`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:error-code-provenance` at the final head: exit 0, `scanned 2986 files; 380 registered-code stamp site(s): 361 listed, 19 waived` and the same `OK` line. The counts moved by one file and one site from the base reading above because of `main`'s incoming `driver-sql` change. The `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` sites are still the same four listed ones.
- Consumer suites: not owed and not run. No export, signature or wire byte changed, and the end-to-end doors above (`createHonoApp` over the rebuilt `dist/`) were measured directly.
- Every family CI runs on this PR is reported on its check-runs.

## Changeset

`.changeset/23714-unique-violation-arm-relay.md`, `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` and `@objectstack/runtime`. It says there is no behaviour change and describes the source-shape change. The dispatch left the call to the `Check Changeset` gate, and under this repo's rules the gate needs one:

- Both packages' `files[]` ship `dist/`, and the rebuilt `dist/` changed (the new identifier is in the built files, and the literal is gone). So this PR publishes changed bytes from two released packages, and `skip-changeset` (for a diff that publishes nothing) does not apply.
- `check-empty-changeset` refuses an added empty-frontmatter changeset, so an empty one is not an option.
- This dispatch writes no labels.

The changeset describes no behaviour change, because none happened.

## Acceptance notes

- At each site `structuredCodeAnswer` is now asked twice for the engine's class: once for the code, and once by the context helper. It is a pure function on an error path only. Passing the arm between them would change `declaredArmContext`'s signature, which is out of this card's surface.
- `declaredArmContext` (Hono) and `duplicateArmContext` (dispatcher) now carry the same agreement rule, status and code against the decided envelope. They stay two module-local functions, one per package, as the dispatch directed.
- `content/docs/releases/` is untouched. No docs edit: no published sentence names the literal at these sites.
